THE CREATION OF THE CENTRAL EAST ASIA
GROWTH CIRCLE PROGRAM. There is hereby created under the Office of
the President, a program which is initially to be called the Central East
Asia Growth Circle and hereinafter called the CEA-GC, and which shall
promote and encourage the active and extensive economic cooperation of
the economies above-mentioned in the area of the South China Sea.

IMPLEMENTATION STRATEGY. The CEA-GC program
shall be implemented
by adopting a strategy of phased progression in
establishing
economic cooperation with focus areas within the Growth
Circle resulting in a multilateral
economic cooperation agreement among
the member countries.
